rca_of_the_issue: Previous agent added 'airport' to VALID_DEMO_TYPES (line 2045) and to DEMO_REGISTRY/DEMO_ROUTE_BY_TYPE, but MISSED updating the three Pydantic Field regex patterns at lines 1108 (ShareDemoIn), 2049 (DemoSessionStartIn), 2227 (DemoSessionSaveIn). FastAPI validates the payload against the Pydantic model BEFORE the VALID_DEMO_TYPES check runs, so every /api/demo/session/start with demo_type='airport' was rejected with HTTP 422 before any route handler executed. Reproduction: curl -X POST /api/demo/session/start -d '{"demo_type":"airport","session_id":"x","total_scenes":9}' → 422 string_pattern_mismatch. Fix: added |airport to the three patterns. Verified 201/200 responses post-fix.
